scope: Existing frozen experiments, independently recomputed arithmetic/rankings and new post-hoc clustered uncertainty analysis. Replays saved separately. No new blind trial.

analysis_protocol.purpose: Verify saved frozen SourceBridge results and quantify paired variability without changing methods, attacks, targets, budgets or thresholds.
analysis_protocol.public_comparisons: SourceBridge proper MLNI minus every saved interface; primary presentation includes all four published papers, both FETD cores, equally enhanced proper MLNI and median/midpoint controls.

statistics.public_cluster: Date: all stations, attacks and methods stay together. Circular moving-block bootstrap over all 28 dates with block lengths 1, 3, 7; 7-day is main sensitivity. Not a confirmatory test or familywise claim.
statistics.public_estimand: Difference in aggregate RMSE from event-level clean squared errors or event-level maximum squared error over the frozen 14-element library.
statistics.procurement_cluster: Seed: all six pools, two budgets and four precision requests stay together. Report seed-mean conditional fractional savings and per-radius conditional request-weighted savings, with percentile intervals; infeasible requests remain explicit and excluded only from conditional cost statistics.
statistics.prohibited: No test of the tautological optimal-objective noninferiority; no selection of favorable block length or comparator.

analysis_protocol.replay: First and last valid event in lexicographic event order, both profiles and every frozen attack (64 cases). Recompute all 13 nominal/midpoint interfaces, two compositions, exact packet certificates, using only saved purchased input and frozen parameters. Compare to saved outputs; do not load evaluator truth during prediction.
analysis_protocol.source_policy: Original project is read-only; disable Python bytecode, write all outputs under current work/experiments.

protocol.scope: Later public time holdout, previously seen stations; semi-synthetic sources and intervals
protocol.extraction: Only fixed target station/hour12 and anchor station/hours11,13 on 28 declared dates. Preserve missing, conflict, negatives and domain violations. No value selection.

proper_prior.residual_variance: population variance after unchanged WLS and public-domain normalization

scaling.scope: Mathematical enumeration control; zero new literature baseline papers

summary.scope: Locked new-seed confirmation in the previously selected wide-anchor simulation scenario; no external real-world validation

independent_audit.scope: Independent CSV arithmetic and seed-cluster bootstrap audit; no prediction reruns
limits: Influence and fixed-attack breakdown are post-result descriptive analyses; all40 seeds retained.
Secondary intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted; method rankings do not constitute simultaneous SOTA inference.
Safety flag consistency checked from saved summary, without independently re-solving1280 exact posteriors.
Primary clean tolerance is a point estimate threshold, not a statistical noninferiority test.
Conditional fresh-seed simulation is not external crowdsensing validation or native multimodal evidence.

actual_replay.scope: Actual recomputation of frozen purchased input. Reproduction, not new data or a new confirmation.
